findings.title: Vite dev server path traversal / arbitrary file read (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9, GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r, GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583, GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw, GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22, GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff)
findings.impact: Local dev server can be abused to read files outside the project root, bypass fs.deny, or execute scripts via custom middleware. Production build (dist/) is not affected.

findings.title: Zod memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5)
findings.impact: Malformed/oversized input can exhaust memory. zod is not imported anywhere in src/ (grep returned no hits), so direct impact is nil, but it is a transitive dep and should stay patched.

findings.title: launch-editor arbitrary command execution / NTLMv2 hash disclosure (GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3, GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm)
findings.impact: Dev-only. Affects the `vite` editor integration. Not reachable from the production build.
findings.replacement: pulled in by npm audit fix (transitive)

findings.title: JSON.parse on localStorage without validation or error handling
findings.impact: A corrupt or malicious value in `accessibility_settings` (same-origin, so only JS running on the page can write it) would throw an uncaught exception on load, breaking the page. No DOM injection risk because only typed primitives are read.
findings.replacement: try/catch around parse + typeof/boolean guards on every field + removeItem on corrupt data

findings.title: External links use rel="noreferrer" without rel="noopener"
findings.impact: Without `noopener`, the opened page can access `window.opener` and navigate the parent tab. All 6 fixed.
findings.replacement: rel="noopener noreferrer" on every target=_blank anchor

findings.title: Remaining 7 moderate vulnerabilities in @typescript-eslint (transitive dev dependency)
findings.impact: Dev-only (eslint). Not shipped to production. Requires `npm audit fix --force` (breaking) or manual version pinning to clear.

notes: Site is a static SPA: no server, no auth, no user input, no forms, no cookies. Attack surface is limited to client-side storage and external links.
No XSS surface found: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no user-controlled values rendered into the DOM.
PDFs are served as static downloads; no content is parsed or rendered.
Vite dev server findings (F-001) apply only to local `npm run dev`, not the production build.
